raw_text: Has anyone seen these claims from Chinese media saying COVID came from India? Global Times is citing a preprint about sewage samples from Mumbai and Delhi. The study authors have no previous virology publications and the methodology section is basically copy-pasted from an unrelated paper. Feels like state-sponsored disinfo to me but curious what actual scientists think.
clean_text: Reddit users on r/Coronavirus discussed Chinese media claims about Indian COVID origins, noting the cited preprint authors lack virology credentials and the methodology appears plagiarized.
